ethics: Approval SEU-EC-2026-0059 issued 19 October 2026 following review on 12 October; the protocol covers the human evaluation and the analysis and publication of study materials. The reported domain review and requester evaluation were conducted on 20-23 October 2026, after approval
participant_publication_scope: All contributors gave written informed consent, participated without remuneration, and authorized analysis and open public release of all study data, including item-level records
public_metadata_qualification: The complete institutional bibliography contains public author names and ORCIDs, possibly including participants as ordinary authors. No explicit author-to-participant crosswalk is included. This is not irreversible anonymization.
third_party_text: Third-party publication text, OpenAlex metadata and model assets retain their source terms; MIT covers author-controlled contributions only
study_data_license: MIT for author-controlled study data and records, to the extent the authors are entitled to license them
authorization_source: Written informed consent and release authorization collected from every contributor during the formal evaluation round, 20-23 October 2026
publication_note: Repository contents for v1.0.0; public availability is verified by the remote repository. Archived on Zenodo on 23 October 2026: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23585660.
